tools.name: search_solutions
tools.description: Searches the HODDS catalogue of software, SaaS, APIs and online services, organised by business process, for records that match a need written in English or French (for example "transcribe my meetings" or "automatiser mes workflows"). tools.name: get_solution

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: Returns the HODDS process taxonomy: groups (for example "Run the business") and processes (for example "invoice-and-get-paid"), with English and French labels and the number of catalogue records per process. A process id is accepted as the `process` filter of search_solutions. Read-only.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Stores a declarative outcome report for an option returned by search_solutions: outcome YES (the option met the need), PARTLY or NO, with the request_id and the option id exactly as returned. tools.name: get_watch

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: Lists the watches of the organisation with their challenger and number of pending alerts; include_closed adds the watches closed in the last 30 days. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

tools.name: set_current_choice
tools.description: Sets a solution by id or free name (any process), null clears. Returns the watch; challenger recomputed later. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

tools.name: ack_alerts
tools.description: Acknowledges alerts of one watch (alert_ids, or all: true for every alert of this watch); the only call that empties the pending delivery. tools.name: rate_alert
tools.description: Marks one alert relevant or not_relevant, with an optional note of at most 500 characters. It never changes ranking. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

tools.name: unwatch_need
tools.description: Closes a watch; its need, constraints and alerts are erased 30 days after closing. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

tools.name: get_creator_plan
tools.description: Returns the demand data subscription of the organisation of the token: plan NONE or SUBSCRIBED, subscribed processes, pending removals, the coming invoice, payment provider and invoices. €10 excl. VAT per process per month, invoiced by VORAN, paid through Stripe; no effect on ranking. Contract 0.3.1

tools.name: set_creator_processes
tools.description: Replaces the list of subscribed processes. Without an active subscription the result has status 402 and a Stripe Checkout destination for a person to open. With one, an addition through this tool also answers status 402 with the Plan page as destination: nothing is charged here, only the page charge

tools.name: cancel_creator_plan
tools.description: Stops the subscription at the end of the paid period. Listings, claims, declarations and ranking are unchanged; the coarse demand table stays free. Contract 0.3.1. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_solutions, watch_need, compare_solutions, find_comparable_solutions · Private data: search_solutions, get_solution, list_processes, send_feedback, watch_need, get_watch, list_watches, set_current_choice, ack_alerts, rate_alert, unwatch_need, get_creator_plan, set_creator_processes, list_gaps, cancel_creator_plan, get_plan, cancel_plan · Public sink: send_feedback, compare_solutions, find_comparable_solutions · Destructive: list_processes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_solutions, watch_need, compare_solutions, find_comparable_solutions · Private data: search_solutions, get_solution, list_processes, send_feedback, watch_need, get_watch, list_watches, set_current_choice, ack_alerts, rate_alert, unwatch_need, get_creator_plan, set_creator_processes, list_gaps, cancel_creator_plan, get_plan, cancel_plan · Public sink: send_feedback, compare_solutions, find_comparable_solutions · Destructive: list_processes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
